groups.title: Public PoC, customer and execution status
groups.correction_principle: Identify public-information proposals, synthetic UI mockups, cached demonstrations and verified implementations separately.
groups.publication_gate: Publicly releasable customer authorization, actual data/connection provenance, reproducible artifacts and dated execution evidence; otherwise publish only a proposed/illustrative status.

cases.issue: The description calls proposed PoCs industry-validated working assets without execution evidence; identify the proposal/mock status or supply reproducible verification.
Public verifiability, working live demonstrations and eight-week delivery are asserted without linked assets or assumptions; distinguish provenance, implementation state and estimates.
A 50% six-month ABO churn rate looks like a company result without data; label the synthetic assumption or provide a public measurement.
The script presents real AMWAY data and live integrations as operating; retain proposal/synthetic status until publicly releasable evidence exists.
The linked static SAMPLE Mock Demo is conflated with deployed AWS/customer validation; identify it as a synthetic UI artifact.
Live real-data delivery within eight weeks is asserted over a mock UI; distinguish the public proposal, mock and deployment/access prerequisites.
An assumption-based plan marks all readiness checks complete and fixes inconsistent cohort totals; keep unverified checks open and reconcile provenance/counts.
A public-only proposal asserts real/live results and inconsistent 50K totals; identify a customer-independent proposed PoC and reconcile counts.
The script claims acquired real members/SKUs/streams/delivery logs and live integrations despite a mock preview; identify proposal/mock/cache status.
The script asserts live customer personal data and four external integrations without public evidence; identify a proposal/synthetic mock and actual connection state.
Absolute competitor-exclusivity claims lack a complete market basis and differ by locale; describe concrete intended features and supported differences only.
Public-information-only work is described as live execution/integration complete; distinguish customer-independent mock and actual verified connectivity.
The script asserts real/live members, cold-chain data, one-minute responses and owned KFC without evidence; retain public/synthetic proposal status and separate partners.
Large-population transition/sales/violation figures and competitor-impossibility claims are unsupported; label synthetic or provide scoped public comparison evidence.
A public-only proposal implies integration of millions of real members while the script claims 5K live data; identify synthetic PoC status consistently.

groups.title: Server authorization, consent and identity boundaries
groups.correction_principle: Enforce authenticated object/row/tool permissions and valid purpose/channel consent before data access or action; presentation personas and content filters are separate.
groups.publication_gate: Server authorization/consent contracts, missing-value handling and scoped allow/deny tests; no UI-only enforcement claim.

cases.issue: Guardrails is listed as enforcing marketing consent; move authenticated consent and data-access checks into the application/tool layer.
Persona switching appears to weaken consent/PII guards; preserve mandatory controls and enforce authenticated roles server-side.
Zero minor nodes does not prove enrollment blocking and age_band is missing; distinguish missing data from tested deny events.
Client persona/rootId can select an organization without authenticated scope enforcement; reject cross-organization IDs using server-verified identity.
UI personas P3/P5 are granted write permission without verified roles; bind tool permissions to authenticated identity and explicit action approval.
Input/output filtering does not enforce enrollment/campaign consent and age on direct API calls; implement server-side checks and unknown handling.
Authorization is described only beyond five levels and zero minors is treated as validation; enforce every root lookup and test policy denials.
Persona choice changes mandatory consent/PII protection; preserve baseline safeguards and enforce roles server-side.
Queries omit the promised cohort filter and real status substitutes for consent; enforce server cohort restrictions and separate valid channel consent.
Name hashes can collide and be guessed and are not anonymity; separate stable tokenized IDs, key handling and display aliases.
DynamoDB TTL deletion does not enforce exact session/rate-limit expiry; check expiry during requests and use atomic conditional counters.
UI persona/content-consent checks are conflated with write authorization; define server role, tool, consent and approval boundaries.
Masking names/contact details does not authorize an integrated personal journey; enforce server object/row/purpose/consent checks.
Model filtering is conflated with tool consent/age authorization and exact masking formats; define independent enforcement/rendering and unknown handling.
Guard toggles may disable mandatory controls; restrict them to sandbox demonstration and retain server safeguards.
Member profiles lack object/purpose authorization and longtail_score lacks a formula; enforce server scope and define scoring period/population.
Optional model-selected pii_mask is not mandatory protection and graph-query scope is absent; enforce server masking, roles and query bounds.
Content topics, tax/advertising policy and persona authorization are conflated and passport hashes do not define profile protection; specify field-level server controls.
Long-term member memory lacks identity namespace, staff/customer authorization and revocation/deletion rules; specify isolation and consent lifecycle.
Optional pii_mask and unbounded neptune_query do not enforce mandatory member/brand protection; define server roles, row scope and query limits.
Content guards are treated as BU isolation, age/legal compliance and hash anonymity; separate JWT/ACL/tool controls, pseudonymous IDs and content policy.
Autonomous calls lack BU/cohort/time/read-write/failure contracts and optional pii_mask is not enforcement; require server validation and mandatory protection.
Persona price blocks do not implement verified BU/age isolation across tools/search/memory; enforce authenticated object ACLs and distinct policies.
Hashed IDs retain linked purchase identifiability and price hiding is not BU/member isolation; define pseudonymization, retention and server access.

groups.title: Guardrails product scope and application controls
groups.correction_principle: Separate documented content filters, denied topics and sensitive-information checks from business authorization, generation, consent and regulatory judgment.
groups.publication_gate: Versioned public product capabilities and concrete application integration; no universal misinformation, masking or compliance guarantee.

cases.issue: Misinformation is incorrectly treated as a default content category; distinguish official filters, denied topics and grounding checks.
Automatic ad rewriting lacks a generator, recheck and reviewer step; separate generation from guardrail evaluation and approval.
Default topics are mixed with ad, age and consent policies; distinguish product filters from application rules.
Consent and age access controls are presented as content-filter capabilities; separate server policies and Guardrails.
Misinformation and business rules are presented as four built-in filters; distinguish official categories, custom topics, PII and application policy.
Four topics, consent and minors are bundled as product capability; separate official filters from server consent/age enforcement.
Misinformation, consent, age and automatic rewriting are treated as one built-in guard; separate product filtering, server enforcement and generation/recheck.
Content filtering is presented as consent/minor/VAT eligibility enforcement; separate product checks from server transaction/member policy.
Built-in misinformation and PDPA compliance from masking/cross-border consent are overstated; separate product checks, server controls and scoped processing obligations.

groups.title: Jurisdiction-specific legal and policy claims
groups.correction_principle: Identify jurisdiction, transaction/product, effective date, scope and exceptions; distinguish legal duties, voluntary codes and application policy.
groups.publication_gate: Public primary law/regulator/policy text and qualified scope review; uncertain legal conclusions remain unresolved.

cases.issue: US advertising oversight and EU voluntary codes are conflated with FDA/law; specify FTC/FDA roles, issuer, jurisdiction and legal status.
FDA preapproval and EU 14-day refunds are unconditional simplifications; distinguish claim/media types, withdrawal, repayment clocks and exceptions.
Part 437 is applied to all direct selling and sample phrases are declared illegal without context; specify applicability and human review.
The FTC event lacks an identified regulation and effective date; cite the specific public rule or mark a fictional event.
Crawling is declared PDPA-compliant without jurisdiction, terms or processing basis; keep it a candidate source pending scoped review.
Taiwan's seven-day withdrawal period is mislabeled a seven-day refund deadline; distinguish applicable transactions/exceptions and the separate repayment clock.
Minor filtering does not establish compliance with Taiwan online alcohol sales restrictions; distinguish synthetic tests from verified sales-method/age conditions.
Foreigner status alone does not establish tourist VAT refund eligibility or row access; distinguish VAT refund/duty-free conditions and server permissions.
Minor luxury-marketing and price checks mix optional policy with unspecified law; identify scope, official clauses and uncertainty/review behavior.

groups.title: Company identity, ownership, brand and dated business facts
groups.correction_principle: Use precise legal entities, ownership versus partnership/distribution, historical dates and defined population/store units.
groups.publication_gate: Dated public corporate filings, official brand/member policies or company releases; unknown identities must not be guessed.

cases.issue: Amway PV is Point Value, not Personal Volume; separately define personal and group aggregation.
Store, luxury-brand and market-rank counts lack dates/units and differ from official store/hall/all-brand counts; cite scoped dated figures.
Aimo is not identified by a verified legal/brand name or competitive source; retain identity as unresolved rather than guessing.
English brand names are conflated and owned brands are mixed with bottling/distribution relationships; verify names and legal commercial relationships.
Fubon-group association is misreported as a Fubon Financial subsidiary; use dated filings and the precise TWM/WMT/momo ownership chain.
Traffic rank, delivery name/conditions and Kakao channel are unverified; scope public SKU counts and provide dated official business sources.
Black/Platinum/Gold is presented as an official membership structure without program evidence; label fictional tiers or cite dated official conditions.
Luxury-store floor placement lacks precise Xinyi hall/store keys and turnover meaning; identify official locations or synthetic layout and define the metric.
A real LV/Chanel 50% discount conflicts with LV's public no-sale policy; use fictional promotions, no-match tests or verified distinct benefits.
A real LV 50% sale conflicts with official policy; use a fictional promotion/no-match example or distinguish verified price/points/card benefits.
700 brands/19 stores differ from official store/hall/all-brand counts without historical/subset scope; use dated defined units or synthetic scale.
Membership lounge/valet and 24-hour benefits are unverified official-looking policies; label fictional or cite program-specific terms and exceptions.
The claim that foreigners, especially Japanese customers, dominate revenue lacks a dated public breakdown; cite one or keep it a hypothesis.
LV/Chanel discount promises conflict with public policy and FX effects lack identification; use fictional/no-match promotion and qualified FX simulation.
Store/brand counts, membership tiers and duty-free operation lack exact official scope; separate dated business facts from fictional PoC assumptions.
LV sale results are promised despite no-sale policy and agenda duration conflicts; use verified/fictional benefits and reconcile timings.
OPENPOINT tier transitions appear to be official policy without terms; identify fictional PoC segments or provide dated program definitions.
Historical Carrefour naming is mixed with the current Uni-PROSPERiTY site title; map observation-period names without inferring an unverified transition date/legal identity.
The 25-class/five-BU label conflicts with 26 classes/six names and treats KFC as owned; separate entities, brands and partners and reconcile counts.
RT-Mart is used as a current 2026 competitor despite the official 2025 MEGA PXMART transition; label period-specific names.
KFC ownership and current Carrefour/RT-Mart naming are misstated; separate owned BUs/partners and dated brand mappings.
Five BUs contain six names and KFC is shown as owned; separate operating entities, partners and manufacturers and reconcile count.
OPENPOINT Gold appears official without a policy source and may be confused with PRIMA; identify a fictional segment or verified program category.
RT-Mart is listed as a current competitor; use period-specific MEGA PXMART/former-name mapping.
12M Gold members and KFC as owned are unverified; distinguish official population, active users, PoC sample and fictional segments/partners.
Undated store/member counts, KFC ownership and current Carrefour naming conflict with public sources; use dated scoped figures and owned/partner distinctions.
Starbucks joint-operation wording can imply a current US equity JV; distinguish parties/licensing and do not infer current completion from a 2017 agreement.

groups.title: Product/API availability and compatibility
groups.correction_principle: Specify exact product, version, region, eligibility and supported API fields; a similar product name is not a drop-in replacement.
groups.publication_gate: Retrieved official service/API/version support and a coherent architecture contract; runtime success remains unverified.

cases.issue: Neptune duration arithmetic is unsupported by the cited compatibility evidence and OF conflicts with HOLDS; pass supported time parameters and align relationships.
Timestream is assumed universally available to a new PoC despite Live Analytics eligibility limits; identify product and customer eligibility.
Nested JSON property access and duration arithmetic do not match the verified Neptune types/API; normalize scalar fields and supported time parameters.
Public/Basic Display API assumptions do not establish current Instagram hashtag access; specify supported API, account, review and permission prerequisites.
Neptune storage is described as instance-attached 64GB EBS; separate compute from shared auto-scaling cluster storage and I/O.
SmartChinese targets simplified Chinese, not proven traditional-Chinese search; verify normalization, analyzer quality and actual service/plugin support.
Unspecified Timestream implies new-customer availability; distinguish Live Analytics eligibility from the separate InfluxDB product and region.
Smartcn is described as traditional-Chinese morphology without support or evaluation; specify normalization/analyzer and deployment support.
The Timestream product and new-customer eligibility are unspecified; identify a supported product/region or justified alternative.
The tool contract omits Timestream product and eligibility; specify existing-customer Live Analytics requirements or a supported alternative.
Timestream product eligibility is missing and a 22-minute Top5 is labeled 30 minutes; specify product/access and agenda scope.
Traditional-Chinese analysis, daily tourism freshness and Taipei-PoP lowest latency are unverified; separate analyzer, source-frequency and routing/benchmark scope.
Smartcn is assumed to satisfy Taiwan traditional-Chinese retrieval; verify normalization, analyzer quality and service support.
The new PoC assumes unspecified Timestream availability; identify product/account eligibility and scope any replacement design/cost.
Timestream eligibility and the Inventory snapshot schema are missing; define supported product plus SKU/store/time/expiry data.
Unspecified Timestream is presented as a new-PoC component despite Live Analytics eligibility limits; identify product/account or a separately designed alternative.

groups.title: Graph, query and event schema contracts
groups.correction_principle: Align node/edge names, direction, hop depth, properties and event/time identities across diagrams, ontology, generators and queries.
groups.publication_gate: A single explicit supported schema and query contract with testable fixtures; do not treat missing fields or joins as inferred data.

cases.issue: The intermediate DownlineLink graph conflicts with direct HAS_DOWNLINE traversal and CHAIN terminology; choose one edge model and consistent depth units.
The generator's parent-to-child edge conflicts with ABO-to-sponsor ontology and a comment does not create a Neptune label; define actual export/schema mapping.
ABO×Product×Brand×BU is not one hop and BU is absent from the ontology; define actual nodes, edges and traversal bounds.
ABO enrollment checks use Customer age without an identity/verification link; define enrollment subject, unknown age and rejection events.
CartEvent is undefined and SubscriptionEvent is not one hop; specify type-specific event joins, stable IDs, deduplication and order.
A 50K-node direct-parent tree cannot have 250K parent edges; distinguish direct edges, transitive closure and intermediate nodes.
The suncare card uses UV absent from WeatherSignal; define source, unit and spatiotemporal join or remove it.
age_band/opted_in_marketing and their age/channel/purpose/revocation meanings are not tied to the ontology; define actual fields and policy scope.
Impression/click/search and experiment-assignment events are absent; define IDs, user/session, SKU/rank, time, experiment/version and deduplication.
SocialSignal is absent and live purchases may overlap ordinary orders; define transaction inclusion, deduplication, refunds and SKU revenue allocation.
Search, pin, view, CS and survey events lack identity/time/access contracts; define supported events and distinguish synthetic links.
Pin sequences, SocialSignal, cart funnel and rating source are missing; define event IDs, times, products, hosts and deduplication.
Country is missing and INFLUENCES implies unproven individual causality; define the node and observational time/region relationship.
Review index names and claimed one-hop paths conflict with the ontology; align document schemas and actual traversal depth.
Journey events lack member/refund/POS identity, time, tier history and access contracts; define joins and avoid counting refunds as separate sales.
Queries require delivered_at, CONTAINS, AT_STORE and units absent from the model; define time, product links and SKU-line quantities.
The generator chooses one home BU and cannot generate the promised cross-BU sequence; specify member IDs, dates, transition probabilities and pseudocode limits.
SearchEvent is absent and BU brands are mixed with SMS/SNS touchpoints while KFC ownership is assumed; separate occurrence BU/channel and partner fixtures.

groups.title: Executable query syntax, cardinality and aggregation
groups.correction_principle: Use supported syntax and preserve event/order/line identity; prevent Cartesian multiplication and define filter/limit/aggregation scope.
groups.publication_gate: Version-specific engine support plus representative offline or authorized execution fixtures before claiming a runnable result.

cases.issue: Embedding/ranking alone cannot enforce age, subscription and percentage predicates; parse and validate structured filters, windows and denominators.
Unrelated new products receive the same Beauty-buyer count because p and p2 are not linked; constrain the intended recommendation or rename the aggregate.
Unicode arrows replace ASCII Cypher relationship arrows; repair executable syntax and verify the supported engine.
Repeated touchpoint/product paths multiply order totals and observed sales are called attributed effects; deduplicate IDs and define allocation versus causality.
Independent OPTIONAL MATCH paths form a Cartesian event product; query event types independently, deduplicate and normalize missing/mismatched timestamps.
Suncare paths duplicate full order totals and join all regions to Seoul weather; aggregate SKU-line revenue once and align location/time.
Embedding ranking cannot enforce 90-day inactivity, price and rating conditions; apply defined structured/cohort/permission filters.
Conversion counts purchases rather than unique buyers and may multiply amounts through viewing paths; deduplicate viewers/transactions and define amount, window and refunds.
Unverified Neptune datetime arithmetic excludes overdue undelivered orders; use supported time values and explicit cancellation/cutoff/undelivered rules.
The generator returns an invalid set containing lists and undefined helpers; use a complete dictionary-based example or explicit pseudocode with seed and event keys.
The tax-refund query starts from a different class than the diagram, uses missing edges and duplicates transactions through products; align paths and deduplicate.
Global LIMIT 5 returns five customer-brand rows rather than five per customer; implement supported per-group ranking or validated application processing.
Multiple daily transactions multiply t1×t2×t3 rows and inflate cross-BU days; deduplicate customer/BU/day journeys and use supported time boundaries.
Independent CVS and hypermarket matches multiply SKU sales and omit sell-through inventory denominators; aggregate channels separately at transaction-line grain.

groups.title: Metric definitions, units, denominators and direction
groups.correction_principle: Define observation unit, numerator/denominator, period, aggregation, percent versus percentage points and historical versus predictive meaning.
groups.publication_gate: Explicit formulas and data contracts with reproducible calculations; unexplained numbers remain illustrative.

cases.issue: The 50K Gold cohort and +20% share lack synthetic status, percentage-point meaning and budget conservation; define all three.
Twelve-month LTV conflates observed revenue/profit with predicted lifetime value; specify historical period or predictive assumptions.
Activity counts and elapsed days are mixed and the inactivity inequality is reversed; use defined counts or days-since-last-activity >=30.
Twelve/twenty-four-month purchase totals are called predictive LTV; label historical purchase value or define the LTV proxy and limits.
NPS is replaced by generic satisfaction; define recommendation scores and promoter percentage minus detractor percentage.
Inventory turnover lacks a matched valuation basis and launch-success rate is an amount; define consistent numerator and denominator units.
Sell-through is used as response rate without exposure/send denominators and external trends are called causal separation; define both data and inference scope.
A 1:99 ratio applies only to 500 real and 49,500 synthetic, not 5,000 real; recompute from the selected cohort.
BM25 12 plus kNN 18 minus overlap 7 equals 23, not 37; distinguish exclusive sets and top-20 output.
SNS +20% and a 50K VIP cohort lack share/budget/cohort definitions; specify relative versus percentage-point change and synthetic population.
Ninety-day observed purchase value is ambiguously called LTV; name historical net revenue or define the prediction horizon/margin/churn/discount.
Concurrent viewers are not unique conversion denominators and a 24-hour delivery promise lacks scope/clocks; define synthetic assumptions and fulfillment conditions.
Exposure share changes to SKU-count share across locales and entropy lacks normalization/thresholds; define list/event units, population, period and formula.
Delivery -15% and diversity 0.4 lack variable/denominator/range definitions; specify exact metrics, windows and thresholds.
An individual's five-point NPS change confuses a recommendation response with group NPS and implies causality; define the unit and qualify the example.
Live-show counts/currency conflict and buyers become transactions in English; reconcile synthetic viewer/cart/buyer/transaction units and compare hosts observationally.
A SOV query returns GMV rank without a share denominator; name it sales rank/share and separate public-mention SOV and supported time parameters.
SOV and shelf occupancy questions return GMV/turnover; distinguish mention, area, sales share and turnover denominators.
Turnover/SOV lack inventory/channel/mention denominators and CompetitorSignal is missing; define independent metrics and the public source contract.
Historical twelve-month spending is mixed with predictive LTV and lounge NPS lacks survey/population definitions; define each independently.
Tourism totals do not supply campaign exposure/response denominators; define consented event keys/windows and keep tourism as aggregate context.
FX and tourism uplift/lag figures lack data and quote direction; define currency pair, baseline, window and uncertainty, distinguishing association.
One +2°C reading is called a universal cold-chain violation and weather joins may duplicate rows; define SKU range, duration, sensors and unique time/location aggregation.
Turnover, sell-through and channel sales share are conflated; name channel share or supply the appropriate inventory/receipts denominator.
Universal +2°C cold-chain rules and LLM ordering are labeled optimization; define contract-specific ranges/duration/sensors and constrained approved recommendations.
Cross-use and turnover denominators plus social/search schemas are missing; define unique customers, windows, BU combinations and separate event sources.
100M lacks currency and SNS +20% lacks relative/percentage-point and budget-conservation rules; specify currency, period and constraints.

groups.title: Statistical models, calibrated scores and predictions
groups.correction_principle: Specify inputs, likelihood/response model, fitting and evaluation; do not equate clustering scores, entropy or R-squared with calibrated confidence or causal evidence.
groups.publication_gate: Data/model specification, validation split, diagnostics, uncertainty and calibration; unsupported model results remain examples.

cases.issue: The z-score and retention/prediction omit moments, cohort and censoring definitions; specify the statistical model or call it a rule-based flag.
R² 0.71 lacks model, sample and period and is called correlation; distinguish r from regression R² and label unverified example results.
Six KMeans clusters have no mapping to five personas or variable-k behavior; separate predefined personas from unsupervised clusters.
Score 0.62 has no defined probability/similarity/distance semantics; define the scale and avoid calibrated-confidence claims.
R² 0.62 and ordering advice lack data/model validation; show synthetic values or reproducible regression and recommendation limits.
Entropy/0.62 are called confidence without normalization/calibration and entropy direction is unclear; define score semantics and abstention.
A prior goes directly to a posterior without likelihood, diagnostics or spend constraints; specify a testable response and optimization model.
A temperature change, R² 0.78 and seven-day FX lag look measured without observations/model; label synthetic and specify validation.
Declining activity/refunds are called imminent churn and annual comparison exceeds the stated data window; qualify signals and define historical inputs.
Order optimization and recovery cost lack inventory, capacity, lead time, demand and prices; specify objectives/constraints and SLA denominator/undelivered rules.
Viewer naming/features, 0.58 score and six-cluster choices are undefined; align schema and specify normalization, missing values and evaluation.
Counterfactual ROAS distributions lack spend, attribution, likelihood, response curves and constraints; specify the model or limit to synthetic simulation.
Survival analysis lacks time origin, event, censoring and session rules and may leak post-purchase viewing data; define a valid time-to-event model.
Customer/Foreigner overlap, matching scores and six-cluster preprocessing are undefined; deduplicate people and separate score design from clustering.
ROAS costs, net revenue, likelihood and +30% share conservation are undefined; specify a synthetic or validated constrained model with uncertainty.
30%/12% and R² 0.72 lack model/sample/validation; label synthetic and report predictive evaluation without weather-causality claims.
Five personas, six clusters and 0.65 lack a mapping/calibrated meaning; define features, k/seed and score interpretation.
Unverified Gold tiers and activity decline are treated as churn prediction; label fictional segments and specify observation window, missingness and evaluation.
12M transition statistics and strong/weak thresholds lack samples, baseline rates and uncertainty; label synthetic and define directional lift/criteria.

groups.title: Correlation, attribution and causal claims
groups.correction_principle: Separate contemporaneous association, attribution rules and scenario simulation from identified incremental effects.
groups.publication_gate: Causal estimand, graph/identification assumptions, comparison design/confounding controls and publicly shareable validation; otherwise describe association only.

cases.issue: Campaign effects and regulatory safety from zero detections contradict the no-causality caveat; report observations and detection limits only.
Trend/SNS and campaign effects cannot be separated without identification/confounding assumptions; qualify the model-dependent simulation.
SMS/tier campaign effects contradict the no-causal-inference rule; simultaneous GMV/points changes need comparison/control evidence.
Search/SNS controls and last-touch/linear/time-decay rules do not identify incremental campaign effects; distinguish association and attribution.
The script claims causal separation and person-level journeys from aggregate sales; require identification and authorized identity evidence.
Live-show viewers, purchases, GMV and rain effects look measured without evidence; mark synthetic and align currency, timezone, window and conversion denominator.
CTR -2% and GMV +6% are presented as A/B and long-term results without randomization, sample or intervals; label synthetic or supply experiment evidence.
Campaign/live effects and example metrics lack identification and data; mark synthetic, align currency and distinguish observed changes from effects.
Host effects ignore product/time/promotion/audience differences and +30% reallocation is ambiguous; use observational comparisons or a causal design with conserved budget.
A pin ±5-minute rule credits pre-pin purchases and overlaps windows; define post-exposure attribution/deduplication and avoid causal effect claims.
GMV, host/rain effects, SLA violations and A/B uplift are presented as results without experiments; mark synthetic or attach public measurement evidence.
Brand/SOV uplift and relocation forecasts lack data/model evidence; label synthetic hypotheses with units or supply validated demand/causal constraints.
Event effects and statistical/turnover values are asserted without baselines and contradict the causal caveat; mark synthetic observations and define units.
Joining tourism and refunds does not measure incremental visitor acquisition; qualify association or supply exposure/comparison/confounding design.
An FX increase implies opposite effects depending on quote direction and cannot identify campaign targets from correlation; define the quote and qualify simulation.
Sales, cross-use, ETL and member metrics are presented as company results/campaign effects without data; mark synthetic and define units/causal scope.
Bayesian ROAS and cross-BU induced effects lack spend, exposure, membership event history and identification; define the model or qualify simulation.

groups.title: Data access, provenance, cohort and individual linkage
groups.correction_principle: Distinguish proposed counts, public aggregates, synthetic fixtures and authorized individual records; aggregate signals do not establish a person's behavior.
groups.publication_gate: Source/access/license, stable permitted identifiers, grain/cohort, collection and join contracts; no real-data or individual-linkage claim without evidence.

cases.issue: Fixed real ABO/customer counts imply acquired private data; mark target quantities and retain public/synthetic provenance.
Company-data counts and 365×N edges lack acquisition status and a definition of N; specify target cohorts and per-relation counts.
Aggregate channel/SKU/period sell-through has no member identifier and cannot prove a personal journey; separate market context from authorized events.
Purchase behavior cannot establish family, marital or age labels and one label conflicts with bias policy; use neutral behavior labels or verified consented attributes.
Member social-activity features lack a join contract and differ from aggregate labeling keywords; define source, linkage, missing values and stability.
Sell-through is not response rate and public mentions are not authorized ad-click data; define denominators and separate source permissions.
Aggregate sell-through is linked to individual visits without member keys; use authorized event identity or label synthetic linkage/market context.
Actual-PoC/5K real-member assertions lack evidence and 49.5K synthetic makes 54.5K, not 50K; reconcile proposed cohorts and provenance.
Dcard 4.5 stars is not verified as a source field; identify the actual metric or clearly define a derived score and sample.
Viewing/purchase behavior is treated as proof of impulsiveness, family structure or delivery dependence; use observed behavior labels and separate verified attributes.
Real/foreigner/synthetic population overlap is undefined and Smartcn is assumed traditional-Chinese capable; reconcile provenance/cohorts and analyzer support.
Real member/foreigner/transaction data are unsubstantiated and overlapping populations change totals; define acquisition state, subsets and dated scale.
Scenarios require competitor analysis absent from the four-source contract; add an authorized public source/mapping or narrow scope.
Tax-refund applicants are not all foreign buyers; scope the sample or obtain the full denominator and align store/category/transaction mappings.
Purchase/refund behavior cannot prove family structure or FX sensitivity; use behavior labels and translate average purchase amount as average order value.
Real 500-member/80K refund data are unsubstantiated and refund applicants are a selected sample; define provenance, unique people and eligible denominator.
5K real plus 49.5K synthetic yields 54.5K and real/PII-masked status lacks evidence; reconcile target counts and data authorization.
KFC OMS and private OPENPOINT/ERP access are assumed available owned sources; distinguish logical fixtures, partners and owner-authorized connectors.
Dcard four-star filters rely on an unverified source field; use actual available metrics or label a synthetic rating scale.
Aggregate public sales indices do not identify external SKU sell-through; limit to scoped estimates with assumptions/error or authorized SKU data.
Weekend/time-of-day purchases are treated as family/occupation proof and social identity is unverified; use behavior labels and separate aggregate context.

groups.title: Temporal alignment, refresh and fallback state
groups.correction_principle: Preserve source frequency, publication lag, timezone, units and event timestamps; label cache/fallback freshness explicitly.
groups.publication_gate: Versioned source fields/frequency, join/window rules, missing-data treatment and as-of markers.

cases.issue: Daily national GMV is joined to differently released signals without timezone, currency, lag or missing-data rules; define temporal alignment and comparison limits.
Cached fallback can appear live; expose cache state and original data as-of time.
Monthly indicators are treated as daily observations without publication lag or time-series controls; preserve original frequency and define lag analysis.
Daily GMV joins omit source release frequency, geography, keyword/product mapping, FX quote and lag direction; specify temporal/source alignment.
The old Tourism Bureau name and promised daily nationality arrivals do not match the retrieved monthly source; specify current agency, dataset, release lag and rights.
Monthly tourism cannot support unexplained daily lags and BU mapping is absent; preserve publication frequency and define valid aggregation/entities.
Multiplication-style joins omit frequency/grain/publication/deduplication rules; define BU/location/date keys and training/evaluation time alignment.
Daily matrices cannot determine exact 24-hour transitions; define raw timestamps/timezones, consecutive visits, repeated journeys and unique-member denominator.

groups.title: Performance, cost, capacity and quantitative outcome evidence
groups.correction_principle: Separate conditional arithmetic/estimates from measured results; specify workload, dimensions, region/date and complete cost/benchmark scope.
groups.publication_gate: Dated primary prices or original measurements, assumptions, formulas, denominator and comparable baseline; unsupported values remain unverified.

cases.issue: The percentage spikes, day-of-month pattern and 24-hour churn surge are unmeasured; identify them as synthetic generator assumptions.
Cost inputs omit token units, region, runtime, OCU type and ancillary charges; provide dated arithmetic or label budget assumptions.
Instance sizing, validation, regulatory checking and monthly cost are asserted without benchmarks or formulas; retain as assumptions/evaluation plans.
Five million transactions cannot fit the stated 500K-edge raw graph assumptions; define aggregation/sampling and recompute nodes, edges and costs.
Request counts alone do not determine model/OCU cost; specify token volumes, hours, region/date and included costs or mark an estimate.
